preconditions.description: The input s must be a string.
The input string s must be non-empty.
The input string s must contain only digits.

postconditions.description: The output must be a non-negative integer representing the number of ways to decode the string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 if any(c == '0' for c in s) else True
postconditions.description: If the string contains any '0', the output must be 0, as '0' cannot be decoded.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if len(s) == 1 and s[0] != '0' else True
postconditions.description: If the string has a single non-zero digit, the output must be 1.
